By when does my cancellation of my working-student contract have to arrive, and when would it then end?

response.text:
Your working-student contract (Befristeter Arbeitsvertrag für Werkstudierende) [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd]:

- **Must arrive by:** Sat 3 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd]
- **Then ends on:** Sat 31 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd]

A few notes from the record:

- To be safe with postal delivery, Ordnung suggests sending it by Mon 28 Sep 2026 so it arrives in time [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd].
- Notice of employment needs a hand-signed letter — email is not valid (§ 623 BGB) [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd].
- This uses the statutory four-week notice period to the 15th or end of a month that applies to you as the employee (§ 622 Abs. 1 BGB); the longer periods in § 622 Abs. 2 BGB only bind your employer, unless your contract extends them to you [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd].
- If you don't give notice, the fixed term ends by itself on Wed 31 Mar 2027 [contract:ctr_jgb50bejm6jd].

You can draft the cancellation letter in Ordnung ("Draft letter") — it's just a record, so you'll still need to send/sign it yourself.
